question: Should `submitText` become a permanent shared plugin-interaction result that supporting channels interpret while unsupported channels ignore it?
rationale: This is additive public SDK surface with cross-channel semantics; tests can establish implementation mechanics but cannot choose the long-term plugin contract.

options.title: Approve Shared Result
options.body: Accept `submitText` as the canonical channel-neutral result after live Discord evidence confirms source-bound exact-once delivery.

options.title: Keep Discord-Owned
options.body: Expose the capability through a Discord-owned context helper or contract instead of promising shared result semantics.

options.title: Defer General API
options.body: Pause the PR until a broader typed portable interaction-action contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve Shared Result
recommendation.body: Accept `submitText` as the canonical channel-neutral result after live Discord evidence confirms source-bound exact-once delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available repository ownership signal for resolving permanent plugin-SDK product direction.
